Recode ANSI by Name

Source: R/recode.R
recode_ansi_name.Rd

Replaces state name with state ansi

Usage

recode_ansi_name(.data, .name)

Arguments

.data

data.frame or tibble

.name

column with state name

Value

.data with column .name replaced with ansi

Examples

data('stata')
stata |> recode_ansi_name(name)
